versions.changelog: Pin every npm install command to the released version, and document the SLSA provenance attestation each release carries so the artifact can be verified with npm audit signatures.

Shopping list: read the list with per-item store and aisle, add/update/remove/restore items, and list stores and grocery categories. Adding an item with no store now puts it back at the store it was last bought at.

Security review fixes: pass search terms to jq via --arg with a literal contains match instead of interpolating them into a test() regex, which mismatched titles containing regex characters and broke on apostrophes. Pin the npx fallback to the skill's own version. Adds shopping list read/write workflows.
Initial ClawHub release. Same 30 capabilities as the MCP server, driven through the plan-to-eat CLI for agents with a shell.
